title: 1851: Isaac Singer’s Sewing Machine Patent Model
authors: Smithsonian National Museum of American History
lineage: Research notes paraphrase specified passages; this is not a reproduction.

passages.note: The 1851 model used a straight eye-pointed needle and reciprocating shuttle for lockstitch, and the museum reports commercial machines were built in Phelps’s Boston shop. The patent date is distinct from the model’s earlier construction.
